Name: <csproj-file>
Description: Root project document with Sdk attribute and child groups

Name: <compile-remove>
Description: Removes files from the Compile item set via Remove="glob"

Name: <using-directive>
Description: Imports a namespace, static members, or creates an alias

Name: <namespace-block-declaration>
Description: Declares a namespace using block syntax

Name: <base-type-list>
Description: Base class and interface inheritance list

Name: <record-declaration>
Description: Declares a C# record or record struct

Name: <field-declaration>
Description: Declares a field inside a class or struct

Name: <constructor-declaration>
Description: Declares a constructor (block or expression body)

Name: <method-declaration>
Description: Declares a method (block or expression body)

Name: <batch>
Description: Sequence of T-SQL statements sent to SQL Server as a unit

Name: <go-separator>
Description: GO batch separator recognized by SSMS and sqlcmd

Name: <set-option-statement>
Description: Configures a session-level behavior flag (e.g. ANSI_NULLS)

Name: <object-existence-guard>
Description: IF OBJECT_ID(...) IS NOT NULL guard before DDL

Name: <function-parameter>
Description: Scalar parameter declaration in a function or procedure

Name: <returns-table-clause>
Description: RETURNS TABLE clause of a multi-statement or inline TVF

Name: <create-function-tvf-statement>
Description: CREATE FUNCTION ... RETURNS TABLE DDL statement

Name: <case-when-expression>
Description: CASE WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... END expression

Name: <inline-table-constraint>
Description: Inline or table-level constraint (PK, UQ, FK, DEFAULT, CHECK)

Name: <complete-powershell-cmdlet>
Description: Holds an entire PowerShell cmdlet as a single text block

Name: <composed-powershell-cmdlet>
Description: Container into which PowerShell cmdlet sections (param, begin, process, end) are inserted via BNF derivation
